Streaming chat completion that includes a usage summary in the final chunk

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hi\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"stream_options\":{\"include_usage\":true}}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chatStream(request)
    println(result)
}

```
